The Division 2 story chronology

The Division 2 Story Timeline & Lore Chronology

Use this source-led Division 2 lore timeline for the Washington campaign, Year One Episodes, Warlords of New York and connected official transmedia. Exact dates are shown only when a source establishes them. Relative sequence is labelled rather than converted into invented calendar dates; same-position, sequence-only records may overlap or be grouped without asserting a fixed internal order.

  1. relative

    Green Poison Outbreak

    Black Friday — Green Poison begins the franchise crisis

    The Black Friday biological outbreak that breaks public order, overwhelms response systems and begins the central crisis of The Division universe.

    Sources: The Division 2 – State of the Game Recap: The Story So Far

  2. relative

    SHD Activation

    After the outbreak — SHD deploys Agents to Manhattan

    The emergency activation of secretly trained Division Agents after the Green Poison outbreak overwhelms ordinary response systems.

    Sources: The Division 2 – State of the Game Recap: The Story So Far

  3. sequence only

    Tom Clancy's The Division: New York Collapse

    Early post-Black Friday New York — New York Collapse's survivor frame

    Alex Irvine's licensed Division companion frames post-Black Friday New York through an in-universe urban-survival guide and a survivor's annotations, establishing April Kelleher's story before Broken Dawn.

    Sources: The Division: New York Collapse Announced

  4. relative

    Broken Dawn Antiviral Race

    Months between the first game and The Division 2 — Broken Dawn's antiviral pursuit

    The source-specific Broken Dawn pursuit of a possible broad-spectrum antiviral, with April Kelleher and Division Agents racing a Mantis-directed operation to reach the Ann Arbor research lead.

    Sources: The Division: Broken Dawn Novel Explores Effects of Global Collapse

  5. sequence only

    Tom Clancy's The Division: Remission

    Between the games — Remission's Washington prequel, without a finer source-established placement

    Jean-David Morvan and The Tribe's licensed Division graphic novel follows four former childhood friends as Washington, D.C. fractures after the biological attack, in a published prequel to The Division 2.

    Sources: Tom Clancy's The Division: Remission

  6. relative

    Tom Clancy's The Division: Extremis Malis

    Immediately before The Division 2 — Extremis Malis reaches the SHD Network outage

    A licensed three-issue Division 2 prequel graphic novel that follows Agent Caleb Dunne from New York to Philadelphia and Washington as a Black Tusk-linked arms operation surfaces.

    Sources: Tom Clancy's The Division: Extremis Malis

  7. relative

    Division Network Crisis

    Several months later — the nationwide SHD Network goes down

    The nationwide SHD Network failure and Washington distress call that draw Division Agents to the capital at the beginning of The Division 2.

    Sources: The Division 2 – State of the Game Recap: The Story So Far

  8. relative

    Black Tusk Siege of Washington

    After Capitol Hill is retaken — Black Tusk invades Washington

    The endgame invasion in which Black Tusk enters Washington, places the city under siege and reveals its campaign against SHD.

    Sources: The Division 2 – State of the Game Recap: The Story So Far

  9. relative

    Tidal Basin

    After the Black Tusk siege — Tidal Basin and the antiviral recovery

    The operation against Black Tusk's principal Washington stronghold that ends with Division Agents recovering the stolen broad-spectrum antivirals.

    Sources: The Division 2 – State of the Game Recap: The Story So Far

  10. sequence only

    Camp White Oak

    After Tidal Basin — Episode 1: Camp White Oak

    An Episode 1 mission in which Division Agents pursue President Ellis at a Black Tusk position outside Washington.

    Sources: Intelligence Annex: Manning National Zoo & Camp White Oak

  11. sequence only

    Manning National Zoo

    After Tidal Basin — Episode 1: Manning National Zoo

    An Episode 1 mission that sends Division Agents through Outcast defenses to confront faction leader Emeline Shaw.

    Sources: Intelligence Annex: Manning National Zoo & Camp White Oak

  12. sequence only

    The Pentagon

    After Episode 1 — Episode 2: The Pentagon

    The first Episode 2 main mission inside the besieged Pentagon, where Agents investigate Black Tusk's search for strategic resources.

    Sources: Intelligence Annex: The Pentagon & DARPA Research Labs

  13. sequence only

    DARPA Research Labs

    During Episode 2 — DARPA Research Labs follows the Pentagon operation

    The second Episode 2 main mission, focused on stopping Black Tusk from extracting strategically valuable DARPA prototypes beneath the Pentagon.

    Sources: Intelligence Annex: The Pentagon & DARPA Research Labs

  14. sequence only

    Coney Island Amusement Park

    After Episode 2 — Episode 3: Coney Island Amusement Park

    An Episode 3 main mission centered on a Cleaner presence at Coney Island's amusement park.

    Sources: Episode 3: Coney Island Live Now!

  15. sequence only

    Coney Island Ballpark

    After Episode 2 — Episode 3: Coney Island Ballpark

    An Episode 3 main mission to rescue virologist Vitaly Tchernenko from Black Tusk captivity at Coney Island.

    Sources: Episode 3: Coney Island Live Now!

  16. relative

    Lower Manhattan Biological Attack

    Before Warlords of New York — a new biological attack hits Lower Manhattan

    The attack that kills civilians and SHD Agents in Lower Manhattan and triggers the Warlords of New York hunt for Aaron Keener.

    Sources: Warlords of New York Expansion Overview

  17. relative

    Warlords of New York Manhunt

    After the Lower Manhattan attack — SHD begins the Warlords manhunt

    The Lower Manhattan campaign that sends SHD Agents after Aaron Keener following the biological attack attributed to him.

    Sources: Warlords of New York Expansion Overview

  18. sequence only

    Pathway Park

    A Warlords of New York main mission in Lower Manhattan that leads to Javier Kajika's final encounter.

    Sources: The Division 2 State of the Game Recap: Balance Changes Incoming With Title Update 9.1, The Division 2 Realism Mode Hardcore | Complete NYC Walkthrough | No Fast Travel [2026]

  19. sequence only

    A chaptered Warlords of New York mission segment in the Raigulus direct capture that reaches Vivian Conley's encounter.

  20. sequence only

    The Tombs

    During Warlords of New York — The Tombs' Parnell thread

    A chaptered Warlords of New York mission segment in the Raigulus direct capture that reaches Theo Parnell's encounter.

  21. sequence only

    Wall Street

    During Warlords of New York — Wall Street's Dragov thread

    A chaptered Warlords of New York mission segment in the Raigulus direct capture that reaches James Dragov's encounter.

  22. sequence only

    Liberty Island

    End of the recorded Warlords run — Liberty Island and the Keener encounter

    The final Warlords of New York mission segment in the Raigulus direct capture, culminating in the Aaron Keener encounter.

    Sources: The Division 2 Realism Mode Hardcore | Complete NYC Walkthrough | No Fast Travel [2026]

  23. relative

    Tom Clancy's The Division: Recruited

    After The Division 2 — Operation: Crossroads begins with Recruited

    Thomas Parrott's first Operation: Crossroads novel introduces Maira Kanhai's Division story in post-Green Poison Washington.

    Sources: Tom Clancy's The Division: Recruited

  24. relative

    Tom Clancy's The Division: Compromised

    After Recruited — Operation: Crossroads continues in Compromised

    Thomas Parrott's licensed Operation: Crossroads novel follows a Division cell drawn into a Gulf Coast supply crisis after the events of its preceding novel.

    Sources: Tom Clancy's The Division: Compromised

  25. relative

    Tom Clancy's The Division: Hunted

    After Compromised — Operation: Crossroads continues in Hunted

    Thomas Parrott's licensed third Operation: Crossroads novel continues Maira Kanhai's story when her reported Rogue status sends a Division cell across the American Southwest.

    Sources: Tom Clancy's The Division: Hunted
